title: Classiq Partners with FreeYa Mind Campus to Launch Quantum Applications Hub in Romania - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Classiq and FreeYa Mind Campus agreed to set up an enterprise quantum software, education and application hub at the campus's Quantum AI Center in Iasi, Romania, with Classiq's Romania HQ and an on-premises IBM Quantum System Two.

insights.claim: Classiq entered a commercial agreement with FreeYa Mind Campus to establish a quantum software, education and application development hub in Romania, integrating its platform with the campus's on-premises IBM Quantum System Two.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Software vendors are pairing with sites that host IBM hardware to build regional ecosystems.

insights.claim: Classiq will set up its regional Romania headquarters on campus to support commercial and academic projects across Eastern Europe, with 12+ partner universities and EU programs providing curriculum and certifications.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Signals Classiq's expansion into Eastern Europe.

insights.claim: The hub builds on Classiq's recent European expansion, including a Naples hub with TEA TEK and a Quantum-as-a-Service deployment in South Korea with QAI.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Pattern of regional partnership-led growth for Classiq.
